note: Sample pack v2 (14 Oct 2026): the research playbook's best formats (research/27 + 24 + 25) in the house look (vc-news layouts, Proxima Nova, coloured numbers). Real data only. BTC: footage/btc15m_1230.json (13 Oct, window ending 12:30 UTC, target $83,255; at 15 s left the app showed $83,362, up $107; it finished UP). Sabah: goal cam Q406 event 17, Sabah 21% before the goal; the app's own line label showed 70% seconds after (polled mid 52%); Sabah won 2-0. Pre-match prices (postmatch list, 1 min before kick-off): Inter 79% / Draw 14% / Club Brugge 7% (Inter 3-4 Brugge: Tresoldi 30' pen, 63', 74', Vermant 87'); Viking 5% / Draw 9% / Bayern 86% (3-3); Galatasaray 11% / Barcelona 76% (1-4, Yamal Player of the Match). Ballon d'Or (Q391): 5 Oct daily close Yamal 43%; live 14 Oct Kane 62.5 (app label 63%), Yamal 30.1, Dembele 2.4, Messi 2.0; ceremony Mon 26 Oct, London. Fed October hike 18.9%, Liverpool EPL title 4.0%, City v PSG tonight: City 44.9%, PSG 31.8% (all 14 Oct). Photos: Bryan Berlin CC BY-SA 4.0 (credit in caption); Van Dijk CC0. Borrowed clips: footage/borrowed/SOURCES.md.
